From homologous sequences - Not in FishBase Indonesia

Detection of a species of freshwater fish, not present in the marine environment but living upstream / probably a species of the Melanotaenia genus other than lacustris (because lacustris is the only 12S sequenced species of Melanotaenia).
More broadly it is the only freshwater fish from West Papua sequenced for 12S, which explains why we do not detect any other DNA.
